config.expression: 'RB01 SCARA' + '\n' + {view.custom.step} + '\ncycle ' + numberFormat({view.custom.cycle}, '0.00') + ' s   vac ' + numberFormat({view.custom.vacuum}, '0') + ' kPa'
'SF01 / UT01' + '\n' + if({view.custom.safety}, 'safety OK', 'SAFETY NOT OK') + '\nair ' + numberFormat({view.custom.air}, '0.00') + ' bar   ' + numberFormat({view.custom.power}, '0.00') + ' kW'
'Last command (#' + {view.custom.cmdCounter} + '): ' + case({view.custom.cmdResult}, 1, 'accepted', 2, 'refused, not allowed in this state', 3, 'refused, interlock', 4, 'invalid command', '-')

numberFormat({view.custom.speed}, '0.0') + ' parts/min   ·   since start: ' + {view.custom.processed} + ' processed, ' + {view.custom.defective} + ' defective   ·   ' + numberFormat({view.custom.energy}, '0.000') + ' kWh'

props.text: Last 30 min: power, machine speed, measured bore (tag history)

transforms.code:
cell = self.view.params.cell
	base = '[default]ANN/FIN/%s/' % cell
	end = system.date.now()
	start = system.date.addMinutes(end, -30)
	return system.tag.queryTagHistory(
		paths=[base + 'UT01/Status/ActivePower', base + 'Status/CurMachSpeed', base + 'QS01/Status/LastMeasurement'],
		startDate=start, endDate=end, returnSize=180, aggregationMode='Average', returnFormat='Wide',
		columnNames=['power', 'speed', 'bore'])
